title: The BI analyst’s skills and responsibilities

videos.script: Helena asked Lívia a fair question in February: what does a BI analyst actually do all day? {{log}} Lívia kept a log for four weeks. Building dashboards and charts came sixth out of seven. This lesson is about the other ninety per cent. {{map}} First the skills, in four groups. Tools are one of them. Analysis, the business and communication are the other three, and the job needs all four. {{hours}} Then the log itself. You type it into your sheet and compute the shares. Over forty per cent of the month went on talking to the people who ask the questions. {{request}} Then how a request is taken. Renata asks for a sales dashboard with everything on it. Five questions later, it is one table, needed by the tenth of March, about one decision. {{duties}} Last, what the company can count on an analyst for when nobody is checking. Definitions written down, numbers checked, and never a number changed because somebody senior disliked it.
